facts.fact: Angop reports that the bill amends Lei n.º 22/11 of 17 June, the Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais, described as existing legislation in force whose provisions the bill alters, adds to and repeals; the document gives no date for the law's own commencement.

facts.fact: The Assembleia Nacional approved in generality, in its specialised working committees, a UNITA-sponsored bill amending Lei n.º 22/11 to widen citizens' and parties' access to electoral personal data, by 10 votes for, none against and 12 abstentions.
